thread:
samir: heads-up: putting final release note for the docs push at 06:30 PT. Draft in PR #8129. Need quick sanity checks: two SDK snippets (py/js), a one-line blurb for the changelog, and a tiny known-issue with mitigation.

kelly: I'll take JS. Found the streaming example using old event emitter style; updating to `for await (const part of client.chat.stream(...))`.

noah: I'll do Python. There's a mistaken call to `client.generate()` should be `client.chat.completions.create()` in v2. Also one embed example uses `batch=True` which is not supported. I'll replace with a simple batch helper.

anya: I'll run linkcheck. Noted one anchor mismatch in optimize guide `/docs/optimize#cache` vs `#caching`. We'll add a redirect entry in infra.

samir: Draft blurb: "Streaming chat and function-calling improvements; batching reduces token costs on common workloads." Known issue: "short streaming batches can produce truncated embeddings on some GPU kernels; use sync fallback."

noah: Mitigation snippet (py sync): `from redwood import Client
client = Client()
emb = client.embeddings.create(model=\"embed-v2\", input=[\"...\"], sync=True)`

kelly: pushed small JS fix (var -> const, await fix).

docs-bot: PR assigned to @kelly @noah @anya for review (24h).

samir: If we get approvals in next 90m I'll merge and tag `docs-release/quickpatch`.
